decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a range of speakers from the ultra-portable JBL Go 3 to the high-end Audio Pro Addon C10 MKII. The Bose SoundLink Color II was a strong contender due to its brand reputation, but a verified review mentioning it died after one year gave me pause regarding its longevity. The DOSS SoundBox Pro+ appeared to be a great value overall pick, yet I was looking for something with a more distinct aesthetic or superior battery life than what was listed. The premium options like the JBL Pulse 4 were enticing due to the light show but felt overpriced for the sound performance described. Ultimately, I did not find a speaker that perfectly balanced price, sound quality, and long-term reliability in this selection, so I chose not to purchase at this time.
